sources.observed_facts: One topology interface owns enabled mode, primary state and node ID; election is constructed internally only for cluster mode with a lock provider.
Startup resolves the database dialect before coordination; creates and pings one provider, then wires cluster, cachecoord, auth, session, and plugin services before route/runtime startup.
Fixed leader-election lock, node holder and lease, follower retry ticker, acquisition state and lease-stop demotion are implemented.
Lease renewal failure logs a warning with context and ends the lease worker, notifying election state to demote.

Local revision branch and shared coordination store calls, tenant/cascade scoping, event payloads, revision fallback, freshness window, observable status and structured publication errors are implemented.
NodeID and IsPrimary are read from the injected cluster service and returned with provider health.
